nodes.name: Trigger: Daily Reminder Check
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at 09:00. Every run scans the whole 'Dates' sheet, so no state is needed here — the sheet itself (reminder_1_sent) tracks what's already been notified.

nodes.name: Config: Reminder Settings
nodes.notes: Same chat_id as the main workflow — paste your Telegram chat_id here too (this is a separate workflow with its own config). reminder_days_before controls how many days ahead counts as 'due' — currently 1, matching the reminder_1_sent column.

nodes.name: Sheet: Get All Date Rows
nodes.notes: Reads the whole 'Dates' sheet — same spreadsheet the main workflow writes to. Every row (one per critical date) comes through as one item, including its row_number (needed later to update the right row).

nodes.name: Filter: Rows Due Tomorrow
nodes.notes: Compares each row's computed_date to (today + reminder_days_before). Only rows matching that exact date AND not already marked reminder_1_sent = true pass through. If nothing is due, this returns zero items and the rest of the workflow simply doesn't run for this execution.

nodes.name: Build Reminder Message
nodes.notes: One message per due row. Flags again if the row had needs_human_review set, as an extra nudge to double-check before the deadline.

nodes.name: Telegram: Send Reminder
nodes.notes: Sends the reminder. Uses the same Telegram bot/credential as the main workflow — select it here too after pasting.

nodes.name: Sheet: Mark Reminder Sent
nodes.notes: Sets reminder_1_sent = true on the matching row, keyed by id. This is what stops tomorrow's run from sending the same reminder again. IMPORTANT: the id is read via $('Build Reminder Message').item.json.id, NOT $json.id — by this point $json is the Telegram node's response (message_id, chat, etc.), not our original data. Any time a node's output overwrites the fields you need, reach back to the node that produced them by name instead of using $json.

parameters.content:
# ⏰ Daily 1-Day-Before Reminder

**What this workflow does:**
Runs once a day and checks the same 'Dates' sheet the main document-intake workflow writes to. Any row whose computed_date is exactly `reminder_days_before` days away (currently 1) — and hasn't already been reminded — gets a Telegram message, then gets marked `reminder_1_sent = true` so it's never sent twice.

**Depends on:** the main 'Legal Document Intelligence & Deadline Tracker' workflow, which populates this sheet. This workflow only reads/updates it — it never touches Drive, Groq, or Calendar.

**Config:** chat_id and lead time live in `Config: Reminder Settings`, separate from the main workflow's config.

**To extend to more lead times (e.g. also 7 days before):** duplicate this workflow, change reminder_days_before to 7, and add a reminder_7_sent column back to the sheet.

### 1. Read & Filter
Get every row from the sheet → compute 'tomorrow' (today + reminder_days_before) → keep only rows whose computed_date matches that date AND haven't been reminded yet.

### 2. Notify & Mark Sent
One Telegram message per due row → mark that row reminder_1_sent = true so tomorrow's run skips it.
